verdict.rationale: YYLO is documented as a command-line orchestrator that runs coding agents in local Git checkouts and worktrees. The pack contains no evidence of a hosted or managed cloud service for running agents without self-operated infrastructure. A managed cloud offering is a fair question for an agent orchestrator, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure
